title: Imagen in Gemini

body.text: Imagen is Google's image model that
excels at realism and rendering text within images
— call it through Gemini, describe in Thai or English, and set the style and aspect ratio.

example: "Create a poster for 'Bangkok Coffee Fest' with clear text on the sign, an evening outdoor market scene, warm tone"

title: Pro-level image prompts

body.text: subject + context/scene + art style + lighting + camera angle
— adding photography terms like 'golden hour', 'close-up', 'shallow depth of field' gives you a lot of control over the result.

example: "A bowl of boat noodles, close-up, rising steam, golden-hour light, food photography style, blurred background"

options.text: Controlling the lighting to feel warm, like late afternoon

question: To get high-quality images with Imagen, how should you write the prompt?
